segments.an4.192:1.3: Saṃvāsena, bhikkhave, sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññena.
segments.an4.192:1.4: Saṃvohārena, bhikkhave, soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññena.
segments.an4.192:1.5: Āpadāsu, bhikkhave, thāmo veditabbo, so ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññena.
segments.an4.192:1.6: Sākacchāya, bhikkhave, paññā veditabbā, sā ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenāti.
segments.an4.192:2.1: [saṃ. ni.1.122]“‘Saṃvāsena, bhikkhave, sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:2.3: Idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:2.4: ‘dīgharattaṃ kho ayamāyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti [satatavutti (syā. kaṃ.)];
segments.an4.192:3.1: “‘Idha pana, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:3.2: ‘dīgharattaṃ kho ayamāyasmā akhaṇḍakārī acchiddakārī asabalakārī akammāsakārī santatakārī santatavutti;
segments.an4.192:3.4: ‘Saṃvāsena, bhikkhave, sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:4.1: “‘Saṃvohārena, bhikkhave, soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:4.3: Idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvoharamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:4.4: ‘aññathā kho ayamāyasmā ekena eko voharati, aññathā dvīhi, aññathā tīhi, aññathā sambahulehi;
segments.an4.192:5.1: “Idha pana, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvoharamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:5.2: ‘yatheva kho ayamāyasmā ekena eko voharati, tathā dvīhi, tathā tīhi, tathā sambahulehi.
segments.an4.192:5.5: ‘Saṃvohārena, bhikkhave, soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:6.1: “‘Āpadāsu, bhikkhave, thāmo veditabbo, so ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:6.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an4.192:6.4: ‘tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto ayaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yathābhūte lokasannivāse yathābhūte attabhāvapaṭilābhe aṭṭha lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti loko ca aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati – lābho ca, alābho ca, yaso ca, ayaso ca, nindā ca, pasaṃsā ca, sukhañca, dukkhañcā’ti.
segments.an4.192:6.6: So ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.an4.192:7.1: “Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an4.192:7.2: ‘tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto ayaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yathābhūte lokasannivāse yathābhūte attabhāvapaṭilābhe aṭṭha lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti loko ca aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati – lābho ca, alābho ca, yaso ca, ayaso ca, nindā ca, pasaṃsā ca, sukhañca, dukkhañcā’ti.
segments.an4.192:7.4: So ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.an4.192:7.5: ‘Āpadāsu, bhikkhave, thāmo veditabbo, so ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:8.1: “‘Sākacchāya, bhikkhave, paññā veditabbā, sā ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:8.3: Idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:8.4: ‘yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhāsamudāhāro, duppañño ayamāyasmā, nāyamāyasmā paññavā.
segments.an4.192:8.6: Tathā hi ayamāyasmā na ceva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.
segments.an4.192:8.7: Yañca ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati tassa ca nappaṭibalo saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.
segments.an4.192:9.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso udakarahadassa tīre ṭhito passeyya parittaṃ macchaṃ ummujjamānaṃ.
segments.an4.192:9.3: ‘yathā kho imassa macchassa ummaggo yathā ca ūmighāto yathā ca vegāyitattaṃ, paritto ayaṃ maccho, nāyaṃ maccho mahanto’ti.
segments.an4.192:9.4: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:9.5: ‘yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhāsamudāhāro, duppañño ayamāyasmā, nāyamāyasmā paññavā.
segments.an4.192:9.7: Tathā hi ayamāyasmā na ceva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.
segments.an4.192:9.8: Yañca ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati, tassa ca na paṭibalo saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.
segments.an4.192:10.1: “Idha pana, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:10.2: ‘yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhāsamudāhāro, paññavā ayamāyasmā, nāyamāyasmā duppañño.
segments.an4.192:10.4: Tathā hi ayamāyasmā gambhīrañceva atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.
segments.an4.192:10.5: Yañca ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati, tassa ca paṭibalo saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.
segments.an4.192:11.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso udakarahadassa tīre ṭhito passeyya mahantaṃ macchaṃ ummujjamānaṃ.
segments.an4.192:11.3: ‘yathā kho imassa macchassa ummaggo yathā ca ūmighāto yathā ca vegāyitattaṃ, mahanto ayaṃ maccho, nāyaṃ maccho paritto’ti.
segments.an4.192:11.4: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.192:11.5: ‘yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhāsamudāhāro, paññavā ayamāyasmā, nāyamāyasmā duppañño.
segments.an4.192:11.7: Tathā hi ayamāyasmā gambhīrañceva atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.
segments.an4.192:11.8: Yañca ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati, tassa ca paṭibalo saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.
segments.an4.192:12.1: “‘Sākacchāya, bhikkhave, paññā veditabbā, sā ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ; manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā; paññavatā, no duppaññenā’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an4.192:12.2: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri ṭhānāni imehi catūhi ṭhānehi veditabbānī”ti.

lines: Na santatavutti sīlesūti satataṃ sabbakālaṃ sīlajīvitaṃ na jīvatīti attho.
Ekena eko voharatīti ekena saddhiṃ eko hutvā katheti.
Purimavohārā pacchimavohāranti purimakathāya pacchimakathaṃ, purimakathāya ca pacchimakathā, pacchimakathāya ca purimakathā na sametīti attho.
Lābho cātiādīsu ekaṃ attabhāvaṃ lābho anuparivattati, ekaṃ alābhoti evaṃ nayo netabbo.
Santanti paccanīkasantatāya santaṃ katvā na kathetīti attho.
Atakkāvacaranti yathā takkena nayaggāhena gahetuṃ sakkā hoti, evaṃ na kathetīti attho.
Sīlaṃ veditabbanti “ayaṃ susīlo vā dussīlo vā”ti saha vasantena upasaṅkamantena jānitabbo.
Tañca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaranti tañca sīlaṃ dīghena kālena veditabbaṃ, na ittarena.
Dvīhatīhañhi saṃyatākāro ca saṃvutindriyākāro ca na sakkā dassetuṃ.
Manasi karotāti tampi “sīlamassa pariggahessāmī”ti manasikarontena paccavekkhanteneva sakkā jānituṃ, na itarena.
Bālo hi manasikarontopi jānituṃ na sakkoti.
Evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, vāṇijo so na brāhmaṇo”ti.(ma. ni.2.457; su. ni.619)–
“Cattāro ariyavohārā, cattāro anariyavohārā”ti (dī. ni.3.313) ettha cetanā.
“Saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro”ti (dha. sa.1313-1315; mahāni.73) ettha paññatti.
Ekaccassa hi sammukhākathā parammukhākathāya na sameti parammukhākathā sammukhākathāya.
Tathā purimakathā pacchimakathāya, pacchimakathā ca purimakathāya.
So kathaneneva sakkā jānituṃ “asuci eso puggalo”ti.
Sucisīlassa pana purimaṃ pacchimena, pacchimañca purimena sameti.
Sammukhākathitaṃ parammukhākathitena sameti, parammukhākathitañca sammukhākathitena, tasmā kathanena sakkā sucibhāvo jānitunti pakāsento evamāha.
Yassa hi ñāṇathāmo natthi, so uppannesu upaddavesu gahetabbaṃ gahaṇaṃ kattabbaṃ kiccaṃ apassanto advārakagharaṃ paviṭṭho viya carati.
Duppaññassa hi kathā udake geṇḍu viya uppilavati.
Udakavipphanditeneva hi maccho khuddako vā mahanto vāti ñāyati.
